nurse.text: Bouônjour, my dear. That's good day in Jèrriais, and I've about all of it left. Welcome to St Helier Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit yourself down. There's tea and a Jersey wonder, which is a doughnut that's lost its middle and found a better one.
There we are. Right as rain, and rain's what we get most days.
The Ark's in the corner. It came over on the ferry and spent three days saying it felt a bit green.

else.text: Mèrcie. That's thank you. Say it to the next person you meet and you'll make their day.
